svg.aria-label: One core divided between four tenants at the ceiling. A single bar represents one hundred per cent of one vCPU, split into the Node application at 38 per cent, Postgres at 30 per cent, Nginx at 6 per cent, other work at 6 per cent, and 20 per cent still idle. The four shares sum to the 80 per cent total that was measured, which is a useful check. A legend lists each tenant with the most a fix aimed at it could recover: six points from Nginx, thirty from the database. The caption notes that on a normal deployment the application and the database are separate machines that cannot take capacity from each other, and that here they can and do.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measured at the ceiling, 2,500 concurrent users.

svg.text: 38 + 30 + 6 + 6 = 80, which is the total that was measured. The parts reconcile.

svg.text: The split tells you where a fix has to land.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tuning Nginx can recover six points at the very most. Removing database work can recover thirty.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: On a normal deployment the app and the database are separate machines that cannot take from each other.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Here they can, and they do. That is what co-tenancy costs.
